1. **Development environment setup**: Install Node.js and Visual Studio Code. 

   ```bash
   # Install Node.js
   https://nodejs.org

   # Install Visual Studio Code
   https://code.visualstudio.com
   ```

2. **SharePoint Online configuration**: Set up an Office 365 tenant and ensure you have access to a SharePoint site.

3. **Application customizer creation**: Use Yeoman to create a new SPFx project and select 'Application Customizer' as the extension type.

   ```bash
   # Install Yeoman generator for SPFx
   npm install -g @microsoft/generator-spfx

   # Create a new SPFx project
   yo @microsoft/generator-spfx

   # Follow the prompts to select 'Application Customizer' as the extension type
   ```

4. **Write TypeScript code for the customizer**: Create a customizer file and implement the required methods.

   ```typescript
   // src/customizer.ts
   import { BaseApplicationCustomizer } from '@microsoft/sp-application-customizer';

   export default class Customizer extends BaseApplicationCustomizer {
     public onInit(): Promise<void> {
       return super.onInit().then(() => {
         this.context.solutionData.title = 'My Customizer';
         this.context.solutionData.description = 'A customizer for SharePoint';
       });
     }
   }
   ```

5. **Testing and debugging**: Test the customizer locally using the SharePoint Workbench and debug any issues.

6. **Deployment**: Bundle, package, and activate the solution in a site collection.

   ```bash
   # Bundle and package the solution
   gulp bundle --ship
   gulp package-solution --ship

   # Activate the solution in a site collection
   https://<your-sharepoint-site>/site_collections/<site-collection-url>/_layouts/15/appinv.aspx
   ```

7. **Version control**: Use Git to manage the project and track changes.

   ```bash
   # Initialize a Git repository
   git init

   # Add all files to the repository
   git add .

   # Commit the changes
   git commit -m 'Initial commit'
   ```
